targets.name: droid
targets.label: Droid (Factory)
targets.notes: Droid's global instruction loader does NOT follow symlinks (verified 2026-08-31 on droid CLI 0.208.1 via fresh-session canary test), so this target is a generated file copy. Re-run sync after editing the canonical AGENTS.md. Droid also injects a built-in commit co-author rule that global instructions cannot override.
